title: How to clear the skill authoring gates for git-workflow and documentation-workflow
context: This change (#786 + #791) adds the git-workflow skill and edits documentation-workflow. paqad-ai skill status says neither has run any authoring gate (S0 justify to S7 release), and the end-of-change check fails a new or edited skill without a passing or overridden release record. The full pipeline needs three no-skill baseline runs, evals against a baseline (and the old version for documentation-workflow) and a trigger test per skill, which is far more than the development agent can run in its remaining turns. Overriding needs one owner-approved authoring.override decision per gate (S0 to S6, 7 per skill, 14 in total), after which skill release records them.
